_notes._: agentHours are wall-clock hours of agent work per package (brief reading, building, self QA, one revision round) with a human reviewer; humanMinutes.standard is reviewer time on the standard package. Estimates, refined by yield data from closed jobs.
_notes.landing_page_web: One responsive page with copy, built and checked at 390, 768 and 1440 px plus one revision; deluxe adds sections and a form, premium multi-page.
_notes.web_app_dev: A small CRUD app with auth and deploy needs design, tests and integration; review of data model and security keeps the reviewer longest.
_notes.ai_automation_chatbot: Prompting, tool wiring, evaluation on sample conversations and deployment; the evaluation set is most of the time.
_notes.data_crawling: One site scraper with pagination, export and a rerun guide; anti-bot handling pushes deluxe and premium.
_notes.excel_macro: One workbook macro or script with test data and usage notes; the client's file quirks dominate.
_notes.detail_page_design: One long product page image from supplied copy and photos, rendered and checked at mobile width; taste review by the human.
_notes.logo_brand: Several concepts, one refined set and source files; the human picks and critiques, so reviewer time is high for the price.
_notes.thumbnail_banner: One image at fixed sizes from a template; fast to make, the human checks text and taste.
_notes.photo_editing: Background removal or retouch on a few images with local tools; minutes per image.
_notes.ppt_card_news: About 10 slides or cards from supplied content, layout and export; deluxe and premium scale with slide count.
_notes.video_editing: Cuts, captions and music on a short clip with render and review passes; render and review time dominate.
_notes.translation_ko_en: About one page of Korean to English with a human proofread for tone and terms.
_notes.copywriting: One page of sales or landing copy with two variants and the slop gate; the human checks claims.
_notes.blog_writing: One researched post of about 2,000 Korean characters with sources and the slop gate.
_notes.kmongGig: Category labels the kmong /my-gigs/new form shows for a listed service: root (1st level) and sub (2nd level), plus third when the form asks for a 3rd level.
_notes.kmongForm: Values for the kmong gig edit form of that category, read from the live form 2026-10-25: meta is the 주요 특징 selects by label, packageSelects and packageChecks are package rows by label with one value per STANDARD, DELUXE, PREMIUM column (작업 기간 and 수정 횟수 come from the listing), scope is what each package covers and is handed to the copy writer so the package text and the form agree.
